parsed_json.up: Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (as target chembl identifier), target_name (as target preferred name). Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno; drug_mechanism to target_dictionary on tid; molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase equals 4; drug_mechanism.action_type equals 'INHIBITOR'. Sort: chembl_id ascending, pref_name ascending, canonical_smiles ascending, max_phase ascending, mechanism_of_action ascending, action_type ascending, target_chembl_id ascending, target_name ascending.
